# GovTrove

> GovTrove is a federal contract opportunity search platform for small businesses, built on SAM.gov public data. It offers boolean search, smart filters, deadline tracking, and set-aside matching across 100,000+ active opportunities.

## Key Pages
- [Homepage](https://govtrove.com)
- [Pricing](https://govtrove.com/pricing.html)
- [Search Opportunities](https://app.govtrove.com)

## Tools
- [NAICS Code Finder](https://govtrove.com/naics-code-finder/) — Describe your business, get matched NAICS codes via AI + correlated PSC codes from real contract data
- [PSC Code Finder](https://govtrove.com/psc-code-finder/) — Describe your products/services, get matched PSC codes via AI + correlated NAICS codes from real contract data
